description: Data a component remembers between renders. Updating it schedules a re-render.
`const [value, setValue] = useState(initial)` declares a state variable and its setter.
`useState(() => compute())` runs the function only on the first render.
Each rendered component instance has its own state. Two `<Counter />` elements never share a count.
A function starting with `use` that can only be called at the top level of components or other hooks.
